payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate over all possible times starting from s, for each check if mirror reflection is valid using precomputed digit mapping and order reversal, return first valid.
payload.rationale: The solution scans all times linearly without branching or pruning, so none of the specific subtypes match perfectly. 'search_branch_and_bound' is the best candidate among given because it is a complete search method, though no bounding is used.
